title: Migrate To ESLint 10
description: Migrate the repository to ESLint 10, update flat configuration and package metadata, and persist zero-touch developer configuration in existing repo settings so linting works without manual local setup.
summary: Migrated the workspace to ESLint 10 by removing Nx ESLint inference, adding explicit lint targets for elements/ui and repo/vscode, installing the ESLint 10 flat-config toolchain at the root, persisting VS Code zero-touch flat-config settings, excluding generated codegen artifacts from authored-source linting, and validating the root lint flow successfully.
